title: Repetition Penalty (Textable, Numeric)
documentation:
## Purpose
A lightweight repetition penalty parameter for machines that apply token-level discouragement of repeated output without full inference metadata.

## When to use
Use this type when connecting a simple numeric penalty value to a machine that does not require override-level controls. For full inference configuration, prefer [Repeat Penalty](https://capdag.com/browse/media:repeat-penalty;inference;sampling;user;task;textable;numeric), which includes metadata and override scope.

## Notes
Minimum value is 1.0 (no penalty). No upper bound is defined in this spec; check the target machine's documentation for practical limits. Values significantly above 1.5 risk degrading output coherence.

## Textable
Coercion marker indicating the value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text.
Strings are textable trivially; integers and booleans are textable via their
string form; structured values are textable when JSON-serialised. Binary blobs
(images, audio, raw bytes) are NOT textable — converting them to text requires
explicit transformation that may be lossy.

The value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text without loss.

## Numeric
Coercion marker indicating the value supports numeric operations (addition,
comparison, ordering). Independent of `textable`; a numeric value is often
also textable (an integer is encodable as text), but neither implies the
other in general.

The value supports numeric operations.
